conditions.scope: Only the specified page window is admissible; page indices are zero based.
conditions.faithfulness: All requested facts must be explicit, linked to exact supporting passages and preserve role, conditions, qualifiers and negations. No technical error counts as correct abstention.
conditions.positive: All requested facts plus warranted conditions; no global unnecessary reservation; exact source quotes are permitted.
conditions.negative: Explicit scoped insufficiency or uncertainty, not extrapolation; quotations of a different condition must be qualified.
conditions.review: Independent non-blind agent review after both arms, using original page images and source passages; not answer_contract status or keyword matching as oracle.
conditions.no_new_test_information_to_product: Questions and oracles are withheld from implementation contributors by workflow until final source freeze. Shared filesystem is not an access-control barrier.
